title: Pan-Seared Fish in Papillote
description: A French-inspired dish of flaky fish cooked in a smoky papillote with a hint of juiciness.
instructions: Season the fish fillets with salt and pepper.
Melt 2 tablespoons of butter in a pan over medium heat.
Sear the fish fillets for 2-3 minutes on each side.
Transfer the fish to the papillote sheets.
Add the remaining 2 tablespoons of butter, minced garlic, and lemon juice on top of the fish.
Fold the papillote sheets to create a sealed packet.
Bake for 8-10 minutes or until the fish is cooked through.
Garnish with chopped parsley and serve immediately.
